name: Who Killed Claire?
source:
Play as Jasper Kieran, a longtime detective and younger brother who comes home early one morning to find his sister Claire dead in the kitchen. Now, fueled by emotion and a need for answers, Jasper must uncover the truth behind the mystery of Who Killed Claire?

[From [url=https://trintrintasticc.itch.io/who-killed-claire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演贾斯珀·基兰 (Jasper Kieran)，他是一位资深侦探，也是他的弟弟，一天一大早就回家，发现他的妹妹克莱尔死在厨房里。现在，在情感和对答案的渴望的推动下，贾斯帕必须揭开“谁杀了克莱尔”之谜背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://trintrintasticc.itch.io/who-killed-claire]Itch.io[/url]]
